 Samsung left-handed reliever Lee Seung-min and catcher Kang Min-ho celebrate after recording a left-field flyout off Kim Ho-ryeong in the top of the sixth inning during a bases-loaded, two-out crisis in Game 4 of the 2026 KBO League Playoffs between the KIA Tigers and Samsung Lions on the 30th at Gwangju KIA Champions Field. 2026.10.30. /Photo=Senior reporter Kang Young-jo Another worry has emerged for the Samsung Lions, who are challenging for their first championship in 12 years. Following captain Koo Ja-wook (33) and veteran Choi Hyeong-woo (43), even the team's anchor catcher Kang Min-ho (41) is not in optimal physical condition. With one day remaining until the first game of the Korea Series (KS, best-of-seven format), the physical conditions of these three key players have emerged as the biggest variable.
 Samsung Manager Park Jin-man (50) stated at the 2026 Shinhan SOL KBO Korea Series Media Day held on the 2nd at the Ramada Plaza Hotel in Suwon, Gyeonggi Province, when asked about Kang Min-ho's participation in Game 1: "I checked again today (the 2nd), and it seems his condition has not changed much. Since he played every game of the Playoffs in a poor physical state, I think we need to confirm until tomorrow to decide whether he will play."
 This is unexpected news. Kang Min-ho had started as the catcher through Game 5, the final game of the Playoffs against the KIA Tigers on the 1st, leading Samsung to the Korea Series. However, it turned out that he had been suffering from severe side pain.
 After the conclusion of Playoff Game 5, Kang Min-ho met with reporters and revealed, "My side was not good, making it difficult to take a full swing," adding, "If I rest here just because it hurts, there is no guarantee that we will make it to the Korea Series again."
 There are reasons for this. In his 23rd professional season, Kang Min-ho became the first player in KBO League history to reach 2,500 career games this year, but he still does not have a championship ring. He also shed tears after losing to KIA in his first Korea Series appearance in 2024. In this year's regular season, he recorded a .267 batting average (81 hits in 303 at-bats), 13 home runs, 58 RBIs, and an OPS (on-base plus slugging percentage) of 0.798 in 111 games. In the Playoffs against KIA, he left a .267 batting average (4 hits in 15 at-bats) across five games.
 'This is what I'm finishing for!' Incredible Samsung Won Tae-in closes out the Playoffs. Samsung right-handed pitcher Won Tae-in cheers as he concludes the top of the ninth inning defense in Game 5 of the 2026 KBO League Playoffs between the Samsung Lions and KIA Tigers on the 1st at Daegu Samsung Lions Park. 2026.11.01. /Photo=Senior reporter Kang Young-jo More important than hitting is his presence in the dugout. With Kim Jae-yoon injured, Samsung shifted Won Tae-in to the bullpen as well, making the catcher's role in pitching management more critical than ever. The battery composition could change depending on whether Kang Min-ho plays.
 Captain Koo Ja-wook is also not fully fit. Koo Ja-wook, who won his first batting title this year with a .371 batting average (156 hits in 420 at-bats), 15 home runs, 102 RBIs, and an OPS of 1.039 in 114 regular season games, suffered a left hamstring injury late in the season. Even after returning for Playoff Game 1, he struggled with a .150 batting average (3 hits in 20 at-bats) and 2 RBIs across five games. Most importantly, his outfield defense was difficult, forcing him to play as a designated hitter.
 Koo Ja-wook explained on this day, "For now, it seems there are no problems with my daily life. Playing in the game is up to what the manager instructs, so I am continuously checking my physical condition."
 Koo Ja-wook's injury also became a burden for Choi Hyeong-woo. After Samsung's lineup managed only two hits in Playoff Game 1, they deployed Choi Hyeong-woo at left field starting from Game 2. This was no small change for the 43rd-year-old veteran who usually plays as a designated hitter.
 Manager Park revealed his concerns, stating, "Choi Hyeong-woo played defense continuously except for Playoff Game 1. He didn't play that much in the regular season either, and he keeps saying from the side that it's very tough," adding, "Considering that the Suwon stadium is large, I think we need to arrange tomorrow's lineup accordingly."
 Samsung left-handed reliever Lee Seung-min and Choi Hyeong-woo head to the dugout after preventing a top-of-the-sixth-inning crisis scorelessly in Game 4 of the 2026 KBO League Playoffs between the KIA Tigers and Samsung Lions on the 30th at Gwangju KIA Champions Field. 2026.10.30. /Photo=Senior reporter Kang Young-jo Nevertheless, Choi Hyeong-woo is Samsung's greatest hope. Recording a .301 batting average (148 hits in 491 at-bats), 18 home runs, and 106 RBIs in 137 games this year, Choi Hyeong-woo also performed brilliantly in the Playoffs with a .385 batting average (5 hits in 13 at-bats), 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs across four games.
 In particular, in Playoff Game 2, he recorded both a home run and an outfield assist, leading Samsung's counterattack. In Game 4 as well, he demonstrated immense presence by setting a new record for the oldest home run in his own postseason history.
 Samsung finished second in this year's regular season with a record of 83 wins, 3 draws, and 58 losses, then defeated KIA in the Playoffs after going to Game 5, winning the series 3-2. They held a 9-7 advantage in head-to-head matchups against KT, who took first place in the regular season with 90 wins, 5 draws, and 49 losses. However, they lost all of their last four meetings.
 The importance of the first game cannot be overstated. In the history of the Korea Series, the team that won Game 1 went on to win the championship in 31 out of 42 instances, a rate of 73.8%. Samsung will field Choi Won-tae (29) as their starting pitcher for Game 1, scheduled for 6:30 p.m. on the 3rd at Suwon KT Wiz Park, facing off against KT's Daniel Davis (29).
 The silver lining is the strong will of the players. Koo Ja-wook stated his resolve, "When I first experienced the Korea Series as a rookie in 2015, it was very scary and difficult. Now, I feel like I can approach the games with fun and enjoyment, like a festival."
 The 2026 KBO Postseason Korea Series (KS) Media Day was held on the 2nd at the Grand Ballroom of the Ramada Plaza Hotel in Suwon, Gyeonggi Province.
